title: 1RB0LF_1LC1RC_0RA0LD_0LE1RE_0RF0LC_1RC---: its rounds are its twin's rounds, in Lean
text: Lean proves on this machine's own table that every token rule of its twin 1RB0LE_0LC0RA_1LE0RD_0RB---_0LF0LD_1LA0LF is a run of it from five entry forms, and that its rounds are the twin's rounds. So both machines never halt under the same single assumption, that every round's defect dies, and the twin's 500,000-round run covers this machine too.
